lessons: The ticket contradicts itself. It requires deleting bootstrap/suggestions.md, but its own `## On-demand` lists that path. tests/test_seeded_phase2.py checks that path, sits outside the fence, and fails 3 tests. Fix the ticket before retrying.

Amend the ticket: drop bootstrap/suggestions.md from `## On-demand` (Goal/Scope can still name it). Or add tests/test_seeded_phase2.py to the scope fence, and change the seed checks so they skip On-demand paths that a delivered ticket deletes.

After the amendment, keep the implementation that passed the first three Verification commands: box.py, git_common_dir and the ingest. The only blocker was the full suite. Do not rewrite working code.

The first attempt already ingested 193 messages into the main checkout's <state_dir>/box/. Signature dedup makes a re-run return 0. Do not clear the box or treat 0 as a failure; Verification only needs exit 0.
